retained_prose.s01: The reception of Your Body, Lord Jesus Christ, which I, though unworthy, dare to receive,
retained_prose.s02: let it not turn to my judgment and condemnation,
retained_prose.s04: who, being God, live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit for ever and ever. Amen.

about: This prayer asks that receiving the Body of Christ bring neither judgment nor condemnation, but protection and healing. Its wording recalls 1 Corinthians 11:29, where Saint Paul warns against receiving unworthily.
explanation: Here ad with the gerundive expresses purpose: receiving healing. The speaker asks for this benefit through receiving Christ’s Body.
